title: The Thursday Chess Corner
story: Priya joined a chess corner in the community hall on Thursday. She had only played at home, so she felt nervous. Her first game ended quickly, and she lost. An older player named Helen sat beside her and smiled. Helen showed her how to protect the king before she attacked. Priya played a second game and thought before each move. The game lasted much longer, and the hall grew quiet. She still did not win, but Helen clapped once. Helen said Priya had improved because she was patient. Priya borrowed a small book of simple first moves. She promised to read one page each evening. On the way home she repeated the advice about the king. The next Thursday she arrived early and set up the board herself. Helen nodded when she saw the book on the table. Priya felt ready to learn, even if she lost again.
